[[File:Elongated Dodecahedron.stl|thumb|alt=3D model of an elongated dodecahedron|3D model of an elongated dodecahedron]]

In [[geometry]], the '''elongated dodecahedron''',{{r|coxeter}} '''elongated rhombic dodecahedron''',{{r|ak2ns}} '''extended rhombic dodecahedron''',{{r|ammari}} '''rhombo-hexagonal dodecahedron'''{{r|williams}} or '''hexarhombic dodecahedron'''{{r|dienst}} is a convex [[dodecahedron]] with eight [[Rhombus|rhombic]] and four [[hexagon]]al faces.

== Properties ==
Given that <math> a </math> is the edge length of an elongated dodecahedron. One can calculate its surface area <math> A </math> and volume <math> V </math> in the formulas below:{{cn|date=January 2026}}
<math display="block">\begin{align}
 A &= 2\left(3\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{15}\right)a^2 \approx 18.14a^2\\
 V &= 6a^3\\
\end{align}</math>

== Parallelohedron ==
{{main article|Parallelohedron}}
The elongated dodecahedron can be constructed by [[Elongation (geometry)|elongating]] a [[rhombic dodecahedron]] &ndash; i.e., slicing it into two congruent concave polyhedra and covering the bases of a [[square prism]].{{r|ak2ns}} As a result, it has eighteen vertices, twenty-eight edges, and twelve faces (which include eight rhombi and four hexagons).{{r|dienst}}

Both the rhombic dodecahedron and the elongated dodecahedron are two of the five types of [[parallelohedron]] identified by [[Evgraf Fedorov]]. In other words, it is a [[space-filling polyhedron]], meaning the elongated dodecahedron and its copy can [[Honeycomb (geometry)|tile space]] face-to-face by translations periodically.{{r|hargittai}} For the elongated dodecahedron, it has five sets of parallel edges called zones or belts.{{r|eppstein}} This produces an elongated dodecahedral honeycomb.{{r|williams}} It is the [[Wigner–Seitz cell]] for certain [[Bravais lattice|body-centered tetragonal lattices]].

[[File:Rhombo-hexagonal dodecahedron tessellation.png|thumb|center|240px|Elongated dodecahedral honeycomb]]

This is related to the [[rhombic dodecahedral honeycomb]] with an elongation of zero. Projected normal to the elongation direction, the honeycomb looks like a [[square tiling]] with the [[rhombi]] projected into [[square]]s.

== Variations==
The expanded dodecahedra can be distorted into cubic volumes, with the honeycomb as a half-offset stacking of cubes. It can also be made concave by adjusting the 8 corners downward by the same amount as the centers are moved up.
{| class=wikitable
|- align=center
|[[File:Elongated_dodecahedron_flat.png|140px]]<BR>Coplanar polyhedron
|[[File:elongated_dodecahedron_flat_net.png|200px]]<BR>Net
|[[File:Elongated_dodecahedron_flat_honeycomb.png|160px]]<BR>Honeycomb
|- align=center
|[[File:Elongated_dodecahedron_concave.png|140px]]<BR>Concave
|[[File:elongated_dodecahedron_concave_net.png|200px]]<BR>Net
|[[File:Elongated_dodecahedron_concave_honeycomb.png|160px]]<BR>Honeycomb
|}

The elongated dodecahedron can be constructed as a contraction of a uniform [[truncated octahedron]], where square faces are reduced to single edges and regular hexagonal faces are reduced to 60-degree rhombic faces (or pairs of equilateral triangles). This construction alternates square and rhombi on the 4-valence vertices, and has half the symmetry, D<sub>2h</sub> symmetry, order 8.

|- align=center

|[[File:Contracted_truncated_octahedron_net.png|160px]]<BR>Net
|[[File:Contracted_truncated_octahedron_honeycomb.png|160px]]<BR>Honeycomb
|}

== See also==
* [[Trapezo-rhombic dodecahedron]], a space-filling polyhedron with six rhombi and six trapezohedral faces
* [[Elongated gyrobifastigium]], a space-filling polyhedron with four quadrilaterals and four pentagonal faces.
